snippet.title: Dreadline Net Quota   Offical Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Fish or die. Launching on Steam Early Access – June 16, 2025

You’re in debt. Deep, cursed, probably-haunted debt.
You have 3 days to hit your fishing quota... or become fish food.

Live demo available now!
